options.content:
## VictoriaMetrics LLM Observability Lab

Companion to the **Erythix premium training** *"VictoriaMetrics as an LLM Observability Backend"*. Every panel and command in the 3 dashboards is documented below.

### The 3 dashboards (Dashboards menu -> *LLM Observability* folder)

| Dashboard | Audience | When to open |
|---|---|---|
| [LLM Observability -- Production](/d/llm-prod) | Business / LLM Ops | Daily monitoring, SLO check, cost tracking |
| [VM Ops -- Cardinality & Performance](/d/vm-ops) | SRE / Platform | When VM itself feels slow, or cardinality climbs |
| [VM Differentiators -- Demo & Training](/d/vm-diff) | POC / Sales / Training | Showcase what makes VM unique vs Prom |

### External UIs
- [vmui](http://localhost:8428/vmui) -- raw MetricsQL playground + cardinality drill-down
- [vmalert](http://localhost:8880) -- alert state + rule evaluation
- [Alertmanager](http://localhost:9093) -- notification routing
- [llm-app](http://localhost:8001/health) -- OTLP-instrumented FastAPI demo

### Quickstart commands (`make help` for all)
```
make up            # start the stack
make diagnose      # health check (5 steps)
make lab3-drift    # inject RAG quality drift (Lab 3)
make lab7-explode  # inject high cardinality (Lab 7)
make lab8-streamaggr  # turn on stream aggregation (Lab 8)
make lab5-airgap   # MinIO + vmbackup + vmauth (Lab 5)
make cluster-up    # switch to Cluster mode
```

panels.title: Module 13 of the guide -- 4 core labs
Lab 1 -- Deploy stack and ingest first metrics

options.content:
**Goal** Deploy the Docker Compose stack and verify end-to-end metric flow.
**Time** 30 min · **Level** beginner

**Commands**
```
make up
sleep 60
make diagnose
```

**Metrics monitored** -- the simulator emits all 10 LLM metrics from Module 5:
- `llm_requests_total{model, provider, pipeline_id, status}`
- `llm_request_duration_ms_*` (histogram)
- `llm_tokens_total{type=input|output}`
- `llm_cost_usd_total{tenant_id, use_case}`
- `llm_ttft_ms_*` (histogram)
- `llm_errors_total{error_type, status_code}`
- `rag_retrieval_score_avg{index_id, pipeline_id}`
- `rag_context_pressure_ratio_*` (histogram)
- `rag_chunks_dropped_total`
- `DCGM_FI_DEV_*` (GPU)

**Dashboard panels** all 14 panels of [LLM Observability -- Production](/d/llm-prod).

**Goal** Write the 5 essential production queries from Module 7.
**Time** 40 min · **Level** intermediate · **Doc** `solutions/lab2-queries.md`

**The 5 queries**
1. **Total cost by model (24h)** -- `sum by (model)(increase(llm_cost_usd_total[24h]))`
2. **TTFT P95 by provider** -- `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider)(rate(llm_ttft_ms_bucket[5m])))`
3. **RAG anomaly** -- z-score over 30 min baseline (vmanomaly `anomaly_score()` is Enterprise-only)
4. **Top 5 tenants by cost** -- `topk(5, sum by (tenant_id)(increase(llm_cost_usd_total[24h])))`
5. **GPU efficiency** -- tokens/s divided by GPU watts

**Where to try them** open [vmui](http://localhost:8428/vmui), paste each query, save the ones you like as Grafana panels.

**Goal** Trigger the `RAGIndexDrift` alert and watch routing through Alertmanager.
**Time** 25 min · **Level** intermediate

**Commands**
```
make lab3-drift     # inject score drift = 0.5x baseline
# wait 15 min for the alert to fire
make lab3-restore   # back to nominal
```

**Alert rule monitored**
```
avg by (index_id, pipeline_id) (
    avg_over_time(rag_retrieval_score_avg[1h])
) < 0.70   for: 15m
```

**Verification** [vmalert UI](http://localhost:8880) shows *firing* after ~15 min, then visible in [Alertmanager](http://localhost:9093) routing to `slack-ai-platform`.

**The 7 production alerts** RAGIndexDrift, RAGContextPressureHigh, LLMHighErrorRate, LLMLatencySLOBreach, GPUMemorySaturation, LLMDailyBudgetWarning, LLMTTFTHigh. One trigger script per alert in `scripts/triggers/`.

**Goal** Measure the 10-100x query speedup from pre-aggregation.
**Time** 20 min · **Level** advanced · **Doc** `solutions/lab4-recording-rules.md`

**The 8 recording rules**
- `llm:cost_usd:rate1h` / `:rate24h` -- pre-rolled cost
- `llm:error_rate:ratio5m` -- ratio without recomputation
- `llm:request_duration_ms:p99_5m` -- P99 latency
- `llm:ttft_ms:p95_5m` -- P95 TTFT
- `rag:retrieval_score:avg30m`
- `rag:context_pressure:p95_10m`
- `gpu:memory_utilization:ratio`

**Benchmark**
```
time curl -sG 'http://localhost:8428/api/v1/query' \
    --data-urlencode 'query=histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, model, pipeline_id)(rate(llm_request_duration_ms_bucket[5m])))' > /dev/null

time curl -sG 'http://localhost:8428/api/v1/query' \
    --data-urlencode 'query=llm:request_duration_ms:p99_5m' > /dev/null
```

Lab cardinality is small so speedup is modest (~3x); on 5M-series prod it's 100x+.

**Goal** Production-grade controls: object-storage backups + multi-role reverse proxy.
**Time** 35 min · **Level** advanced · **Doc** `solutions/lab5-backup-airgap.md`

**Components added** -- `make lab5-airgap`
- **MinIO** S3-compatible storage, port 9000 + console 9001 (admin/admin12345)
- **vmbackup** -- snapshots VM data every 5 min -> `s3://vm-backups/auto`
- **vmauth** (port 8427) -- 3 roles
  - `grafana / grafana-password` -- read-only on `/api/v1/query*`
  - `otel-collector / otel-password` -- write-only on `/api/v1/write`
  - `admin / admin-password` -- everything

**Restore drill** wipe vm volume, run `vmrestore` from MinIO, restart VM. Procedure in the doc.

**Goal** Switch from Single-mode to a 3-component VM cluster.
**Time** 15 min · **Level** intermediate

**Commands**
```
make down            # stop Single mode (port conflict)
make cluster-up      # start cluster
make cluster-down
```

**Architecture differences**
- **vminsert** (port 8480) replaces direct VM ingestion
- **vmselect** (port 8481) replaces direct VM queries
- **vmstorage x2** with `--replicationFactor=2` -- survives one shard loss
- Same dashboards, alerts, OTel pipeline

**When to migrate** > 500k active series OR P99 write latency > 50ms OR HA SLA required.

**Goal** Validate Alertmanager routing without waiting for natural conditions.

**The 7 trigger scripts** in `scripts/triggers/`
- `01_rag_index_drift.sh` -- fires RAGIndexDrift (15m)
- `02_rag_context_pressure.sh` -- RAGContextPressureHigh (5m)
- `03_llm_high_error_rate.sh` -- LLMHighErrorRate (3m)
- `04_llm_latency_slo.sh` -- LLMLatencySLOBreach (5m)
- `05_gpu_memory_sat.sh` -- GPUMemorySaturation (2m)
- `06_llm_daily_budget.sh` -- LLMDailyBudgetWarning (instant)
- `07_llm_ttft_high.sh` -- LLMTTFTHigh (5m)

```
bash scripts/triggers/03_llm_high_error_rate.sh
# wait 3 min, check vmalert + Alertmanager
bash scripts/triggers/_restore.sh
```

**OTel-instrumented FastAPI app** (`llm-app` on port 8001)
- Module 6.1 OTel SDK approach
- Pushes traces (`gen_ai.*` + `rag.*` attributes) and metrics via OTLP gRPC
- Uses **exponential histograms** (no bucket pre-pick)
- Test:
```
curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/rag \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","provider":"openai"}'
```

**Spanmetrics connector** traces -> RED metrics via the OTel collector

**`make backfill`** ingest 30 days of historical cost CSV via vmctl (reconcile billing vs observability)

**`bash scripts/verify_panels.sh`** audit every dashboard panel against live VM and report which return empty

**`make help`** the full Makefile target list

panels.title: Lab 6 -- MetricsQL functions PromQL cannot do

options.content:
**Goal** Demonstrate 6 MetricsQL functions that have NO PromQL equivalent.
**Time** 30 min · **Level** intermediate · **Doc** `solutions/lab6-metricsql-exclusive.md`
**Live in** [VM Differentiators dashboard](/d/vm-diff) -> Row 1

| # | Function | What it solves |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | manual z-score (`anomaly_score` is vmanomaly Enterprise) | RAG drift without static thresholds |
| 2 | `outliers_iqr(...)` | Light up only the model whose latency just broke |
| 3 | `share_le_over_time(m[d], threshold)` | Exact "% time SLO was missed" |
| 4 | `quantiles_over_time("phi", 0.5, 0.95, 0.99, m[d])` | P50/P95/P99 from a gauge in one query, properly labelled |
| 5 | `histogram_avg(rate(m_bucket[5m]))` | Clean mean from a histogram, label-mismatch tolerant |
| 6 | `keep_last_value(m, 5m)` | Carry last value forward -- no false "no data" alerts |

**Bonus** `range_normalize(...)` compares metrics on different scales.

**Goal** Observe cardinality with VM's native endpoints, remediate via vmagent relabel.
**Time** 30 min · **Level** advanced · **Doc** `solutions/lab7-cardinality.md`
**Live in** [VM Differentiators](/d/vm-diff) Row 4 + [VM Ops](/d/vm-ops)

**Commands**
```
make lab7-explode     # inject 5000 high-card series
make lab7-cleanup     # delete the demo series
```

**VM-native cardinality endpoints** (no exporter needed)
- `GET /api/v1/status/tsdb` top labels, top metrics, top label-value pairs
- [vmui Cardinality tab](http://localhost:8428/vmui/#/?tab=cardinality)

**Remediation strategies** 1) labeldrop the noisy label, 2) group via `model_family`, 3) restrict `tenant_id` to cost metrics only.

**Goal** Pre-aggregate cost metrics AT INGESTION (not at query time).
**Time** 25 min · **Level** advanced · **Doc** `solutions/lab8-stream-aggregation.md`
**Live in** [VM Differentiators](/d/vm-diff) Row 2

**Commands**
```
make lab8-streamaggr   # enable, restart vmagent
# wait 1 min, then in vmui:
#   llm:cost_usd:agg1h
#   llm:requests:agg1m
#   llm:tokens:agg1m
```

**The killer feature** vmagent rolls cost from full-cardinality (model x provider x tenant x use_case) to (model x provider x tenant) at 1-hour windows BEFORE writing to VM. Cardinality drops 4-10x. Raw series stay short-retention; aggregated series carry 3-year cost-audit retention.

Prometheus + recording rules can't do this -- they run AFTER the data lands.

- All lab docs in `D:\labs\LLMVM\aiobs-lab\labs\victoriametrics-llm\solutions\`
- Training guide -- `guide_victoriametrics_llm_en.docx` at the repo root
- Slide deck -- `vm_llm_observability_deck.pptx`
- VictoriaMetrics docs -- https://docs.victoriametrics.com
- MetricsQL reference -- https://docs.victoriametrics.com/metricsql

### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Run |
|---|---|
| Panels show "No data" | `bash scripts/verify_panels.sh` |
| Stack won't start | `docker compose logs --tail 30 <service>` |
| Need full health check | `.\make.cmd diagnose` (Windows) or `make diagnose` (Mac/Linux) |
| Wipe and restart | `make clean && make up` |
